player_metric_definition: SportsDataverse team/opponent-adjusted box BPM. Not Sports-Reference BPM and not a causal measure.
availability_policy: Confirmed full-season exclusions only. No complete injury/eligibility census is claimed. Unresolved eligibility follows roster inclusion and is an explicit remaining limitation.
recruit_alias_policy: Five reviewed athlete-ID matches; no automatic fuzzy matching. College commitment is not used to override current roster membership.
